headline: Office vacancies drop sharply in Q2 as organizations seek space: CBRE
summary: Well-located space with higher-end amenities in gateway markets is driving activity even as organizations grapple with AI’s future impacts, the company says.

headline: CBRE Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center and Infrastructure Growth Drive Upgraded Outlook
summary: Commercial real estate firm CBRE (NYSE:CBRE) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 15.2% year on year to $11.19 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.56 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
